g.text: > I want a weekly overview of the lab's freezer temperature logs,
but I have not thought it through. Interview me, one question
at a time, then write brief.md and stop.
Who reads the overview, and what should they do with it?
1. Only you, to spot problems early
2. The whole lab, as a Monday e-mail
> 2, and the lab manager acts on alarms.
What counts as a problem? A single reading above -70 °C,
or a period above it, and for how long?
How will you know the overview is right? For example,
compare one week with the alarms the freezer itself logged?
> Yes, the alarm log is in alarms.csv.
... 4 more questions ... Wrote brief.md. Stopping here.
